data.name: Lost in the tomb
data.detailed_description:
An adventurer lost in the crypt of the ancient Egyptian pyramids. He needs to go through many dungeons to get to the surface.
Do you have multi levels , nice chalk graphics, classic gameplay in the spirit of the old games.
The game has a built in level editor. You can create your crypts to pass.

Logical puzzle game in which the player moves the platform in the maze. You must move the platform to the desired end position. Only one platform can be moved at a time. The hero of the game - "the adventurer" - can only push crates but not pull them. Help brave pass all the tests.

reviews.review:
Lost in the Tomb is a classic puzzle adventure that places players in the role of a fearless explorer who has become trapped deep within the mysterious crypts hidden beneath the ancient Egyptian pyramids. Far from civilization and surrounded by countless underground chambers, the adventurer must navigate a sprawling network of dangerous dungeons in search of a route back to the surface. Every level presents a new challenge, requiring intelligence, patience, and careful planning to overcome the obstacles standing between the hero and freedom.

Drawing inspiration from traditional puzzle games of the past, Lost in the Tomb embraces a straightforward yet highly engaging gameplay formula built around logical problem-solving. The adventure unfolds across numerous stages, each designed as a unique maze filled with movable platforms, crates, narrow passageways, and environmental obstacles. Progress depends not on combat or fast reflexes, but on the player's ability to analyze each situation and determine the correct sequence of actions. A single mistake can leave a puzzle unsolved, forcing players to rethink their strategy and search for a more effective solution.

At the heart of the experience is a classic push-block mechanic that rewards careful planning. The adventurer can move objects by pushing them into position, but cannot pull them back once they have been moved. This seemingly simple limitation creates a surprising amount of depth, as every movement must be considered before it is made. Players must think several steps ahead, evaluating how each action will affect the layout of the puzzle and whether it will open new opportunities or create additional obstacles. Success requires logical thinking, observation, and the ability to anticipate the consequences of every decision.

The game's maze-like levels become increasingly complex as players progress deeper into the crypt. Early challenges introduce the basic mechanics and allow players to become familiar with the controls and puzzle structure. As the journey continues, new layouts and more intricate arrangements demand greater precision and strategic thinking. The difficulty gradually increases, ensuring that players are constantly presented with fresh challenges that test their problem-solving abilities without feeling unfair.

Visually, Lost in the Tomb adopts a distinctive chalk-inspired art style that gives the game a unique identity. The presentation evokes the charm of classic puzzle titles while creating an atmosphere that complements the ancient Egyptian setting. The simple yet appealing graphics keep the focus on gameplay while still providing enough visual character to make the environments feel memorable. The underground chambers, mysterious corridors, and puzzle-filled rooms all contribute to the sensation of exploring a forgotten world hidden beneath the desert sands.

One of the most appealing aspects of the game is its dedication to traditional puzzle design. Rather than relying on complex mechanics or excessive visual effects, it focuses on delivering carefully crafted challenges that reward intelligence and perseverance. Every completed puzzle provides a satisfying sense of accomplishment, encouraging players to continue deeper into the crypt and uncover the next challenge waiting ahead.

The inclusion of a built-in level editor significantly expands the game's longevity. Beyond completing the official stages, players are given the tools to design their own crypts and puzzle layouts. This feature allows for a high degree of creativity, enabling users to create custom challenges for themselves or other players. The editor transforms the game from a simple puzzle adventure into a platform for experimentation and puzzle creation, offering nearly endless opportunities for those who enjoy designing intricate challenges.

The sense of progression throughout the adventure is strengthened by the game's thematic setting. Every dungeon feels like another layer of an ancient mystery waiting to be unraveled. As players descend further into the crypt and overcome increasingly difficult puzzles, they experience the rewarding feeling of mastering a hostile environment through intelligence alone. The absence of combat places complete emphasis on problem-solving, making every victory feel earned through skill and careful thought.

Lost in the Tomb is ultimately a celebration of classic puzzle game design. It combines logical challenges, increasingly complex mazes, distinctive visual presentation, and creative level-building tools into a package that appeals to both casual players and dedicated puzzle enthusiasts. Those who enjoy testing their minds, solving intricate environmental puzzles, and overcoming obstacles through careful planning will find plenty to appreciate within its ancient underground labyrinths.

Whether you are a longtime fan of traditional push-block puzzle games or a newcomer looking for a thoughtful challenge, Lost in the Tomb offers a rewarding journey filled with clever level design, strategic gameplay, and the constant satisfaction of solving seemingly impossible puzzles. The path to freedom may be difficult, but every step through the ancient crypt brings players closer to escaping the darkness and reaching the surface once again.

Rating: 5/10
